traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Amelanchier (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.71 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 7 records in 5 sources); trunks 0.71, branches 0.65. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: calyx-tube campanulate, more or less adnate to the ovary; ovary partly or wholly inferior, 5-celled; styles 5, united below; stamens indefinite, about 20. The Burke Herbarium (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read) gives stamens 12 to 20 and an inferior ovary.

traits.flowering_position.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Amelanchier chapter (read in full): serviceberry flowers come in terminal and lateral clusters.
